question: List the creation date and age of the user that commented with webiste.
evidence: commented with webiste refers to the value contains 'http://'
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching users record.
gold: SELECT T2.CreationDate, T2.Age FROM comments AS T1 LEFT JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.text LIKE '%http://%'
gold0: SELECT T2.CreationDate, T2.Age FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.text LIKE '%http://%'

b.request: List the creation date and age of every user who wrote a comment whose text contains 'http://', using a left join from comments to users so that comments whose UserId has no matching users record are still kept (with null creation date and age)
b.sql: SELECT u.CreationDate, u.Age FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id WHERE c.Text LIKE '%http://%'

d.request: List the creation date and age of the users who commented with a website (where the comment's value contains 'http://'), and also keep the comment rows that have no matching record in the users table.
d.sql: SELECT u.CreationDate, u.Age FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id WHERE c.Text LIKE '%http://%'
